text.neutral:
Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from Halcyon Textiles. The corner protectors in our packaging are recycled and can be put in paper recycling. While our finance contact is away this week, a colleague is answering questions on her behalf. We now use a lighter pallet film; please avoid stacking pallets more than two high.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Bram
Halcyon Textiles
--
This message was sent from a shared mailbox.
